subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: Should Google Chat DM thread opt-in be represented by a new `dmThreadMode` account key, or folded into the existing `replyToMode`/threading contract?
rationale: Both shapes are plausible, but the repository already has `replyToMode` for thread semantics and AGENTS.md treats new config/default surfaces as compatibility-sensitive product API.

options.title: Use the existing threading contract
options.body: Represent the DM opt-in through the existing Google Chat `replyToMode`/threading surface, then update the complete config contract and live proof.

options.title: Accept `dmThreadMode` as a separate key
options.body: Keep the new DM-only knob, but require exported types, generated metadata, docs/help, compatibility notes, and live Google Chat proof before merge.

options.title: Pause until stronger proof exists
options.body: Leave or close this PR until a real Google Chat deployment proves that DM thread targets are accepted for the intended app-auth deployments.

recommendation.title: Use the existing threading contract
recommendation.body: Represent the DM opt-in through the existing Google Chat `replyToMode`/threading surface, then update the complete config contract and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He verified and landed the prior DM thread-suppression fix and has the clearest recent history on this Google Chat behavior.
